import java.util.*;

    static long[] ifac = new long[N], fac = new long[N], inv = new long[N];
    static int[] t = new int[20], g = new int[20];

        long res = c;

        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) res = res * base % P;
            base = base * base % P;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return res;

    static void init(int n) {

            fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P;

        ifac[n] = fpow(fac[n], P - 2, 1);

    static void FMT(long[] f, int n) {
